objectClass.primaryType: foldable quadcopter drone with a 3-axis tri-sensor gimbal
structureKind: branching hierarchy (root -> arm -> motor -> rotor -> prop -> blade)
motionPotential: articulated (arm fold hinges, gimbal yaw/roll/pitch, blade folding)
whole-object transform (lift, hover bob, yaw sway)
objectClass.notes: Classified from the DJI enterprise photo and retail renders, not from a domain template.

reasoning: Silhouette is an X of four thin arms around a wedge body plus 239 mm props; it changes completely between folded and unfolded states.
Six-level chains (M3T > arm > motor > rotor > prop > blade) and (body > gimbal > yaw > roll > pitch > lens) must stay separate pivots.
Identity hinges on small parts: three differently shaped lenses on a 36 mm face, nose vision windows, orange blade tips.
23 materials, from satin enterprise plastic to germanium and emissive LEDs.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Fold, gimbal and rotor articulation plus a detachable battery require stable pivots; identity depends on micro features (lens layout, sensors, blade tips).

resolvedUnknowns: Lens layout confirmed from the DJI front-3/4 photo (wide top-right, thermal bottom-right, tele bottom-left, logo top-left).
Fold kinematics resolved by solving, per arm, the near-vertical axis that carries the motor onto DJI's folded footprint (folded 221 x 96.3 x 90.3 mm).
Remaining inferences (belly sensors, beacon placement, hidden gimbal dampers) are recorded in assumptions/risks rather than blocking.

qualityContract.qualityBar: complex: scale-true M3T hero for a 16:10 web slot that survives a gimbal close-up
definitionOfDone: Unfolded bounds within 1 % of DJI 347.5 x 283 x 107.7 mm and folded within 2 % of 221 x 96.3 x 90.3 mm (no props); plan motor diagonal within 1 % of 380.1 mm.

Camera face reads as the M3T from 0.5 m: rounded-rect wide window top-right, large near-black thermal window bottom-right, smaller bright-ringed tele bottom-left, blank logo area top-left, no rangefinder.
Folded pose matches DJI's photo: front arms tucked back along the flanks, rear motors standing upright beside the gimbal, props folded along the arms clear of the body.
Every movable part (4 arm hinges, 3 gimbal stages, 4 rotors, 8 blades, battery) is its own pivot group with a recorded axis, range and attachment.
Materials read as enterprise slate-grey satin plastic (not glossy, not flat), graphite blades with orange tips, glass with AR sheen, germanium with a violet sheen.

visualDeltaChecks: Bounding-box delta vs DJI figures, unfolded and folded (model.measure(1) / measure(0)).
Front-view lens-layout delta: position and size of the three lens openings on the 36 x 31 mm face.
Folded front-3/4 delta against the DJI photo: rear motor upright beside the gimbal, front arms along the flanks.
Top-view arm-angle and motor-position delta (front 160.3 mm, rear 130.5 mm off the centre line).
Side-view wedge-profile delta: nose shoulder height vs tail height.
Blade plan-shape delta: chord distribution, orange-tip band length.
Grazing-light check of the shell: grain bump and roughness blotches visible, seams dark but not grooved.
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not accept a body that is a box or capsule: it must be the station-table loft with tumblehome.
Do not accept arm components without hinge axis, fold angle and knuckle embed depth.
Do not accept a gimbal without three separate stage pivots and the -90..+35 deg pitch clamp.
Do not accept the lens layout unless each lens names its position, shape and material.
Do not accept blades as a single disc or flat cards: span, chord, twist and tip band must be specified.
Do not pass material look-dev while blade roughness reuses the albedo noise field.
Do not patch referencePbr from an extraction below 0.7 confidence (battery stays unpatched).
Do not add logos, lettering or a laser rangefinder.

albedo.samplingNotes: Reference-derived from foreground pixels; de-lit to reduce baked shadows/highlights.

roughness.localResponse: reference-derived roughness estimate; cavities and textured zones trend rougher, bright highlights trend smoother

ambientOcclusion.notes: Reference-derived cavity estimate from local height minima; verify against grazing-light screenshot.

textureProjection.texelDensityIntent: albedo 1024^2 over the loft (~0.2 m around x 0.14 m along ~ 5100 x 7300 px/m); roughness 512^2 per 0.05 m (10240 px/m); bump 512^2 per 0.010 m (51200 px/m) so grain never stretches on the loft

surfaceFrequencyBands.role: reference-derived broad albedo and height breakup
reference-derived cracks, ridges, pores, grain, or leaf clusters
reference-derived micro highlight breakup under grazing light

localOverrides.region: loft u 0.205->0.225 and mirror, from v 0.12

localOverrides.notes: Use generated maps as material evidence, then refine after browser screenshot comparison.

shaderNotes: Enterprise dark slate grey satin plastic; albedo map shellAlbedo = (0.9 + 0.12 mottle[seed 11]) * (1 - 0.62 seam)
Reference-derived maps are estimates from image pixels; verify with neutral, grazing, and reference-matched renders.
Do not treat baked image shadows as final albedo; rerun extraction with a tighter material crop if highlights/shadows pollute the maps.

builtImplementation.map: shellAlbedo 1024^2 loft-space (mottle fbm seed 11 octaves 6/12/32/96 + panel seams)
builtImplementation.bumpMap: T.grain 512^2 tiled 0.010 m on uv1 (seed 107), bumpScale 0.3
conformanceGaps: shellRough / shellBump (1024^2, seam-aware: rougher + grooved panel lines) are generated but never bound; panel seams exist only in albedo, so they do not catch light as grooves
roughness/bump tiles are 512^2 (texel density is high because they tile at 5 cm / 1 cm)

referencePbr.method: single-image pixel evidence with de-lighting estimate; not photogrammetry

lightingFromPhoto: Key light: DirectionalLight #F3E8D8 (warm bone), intensity 3.4, re-placed every frame up-left of the camera (target - 0.9 right - 0.9 forward + 1.3 up); no shadow maps, so shadow softness comes only from the contact-shadow cards.

Rim lights: two low ember DirectionalLights #FF6A1F from behind the aircraft (0.8 at +1.2 forward / +0.55 right / +0.12 up; 0.4 at +0.8 forward / -1.0 right / +0.06 up) so only edges facing away from the camera catch orange.
Environment: PMREM RoomEnvironment (blur 0.035), scene.environmentIntensity 0.75, rotated -35 deg about Y; per-material envMapIntensity 0.9..1.9.
Exposure / tone mapping: ACESFilmicToneMapping, toneMappingExposure 1.15, sRGB output.
Background: transparent clear (alpha 0) over the section's ash gradient; no scene background.

Contact shadow: radial alpha card (128 px, (1 - smoothstep(0, 1, r))^2) at y 0.4 mm, 0.36 x 0.34 m, opacity 0.62 - 0.3 * air, scaling with fold and lift; four 30 mm foot blobs at the contacts fade in over fold 0.75..1 and out as the aircraft lifts. Vertex AO bakes darken undersides.

Reference photo lighting (not copied): DJI front-3/4 is low-key (near-black background, one soft top-left key, specular streak along the deck shoulder); retail renders are high-key shadowless softbox. Materials are tuned to read in the neutral review cameras first, then under the ember stage.
proceduralStrategy: Body: 16-station table (z, half-width, top y, bottom y, top/bottom superellipse exponents) interpolated with monotone cubics, swept as one ring loft and split at the battery seam.
Arms: per-arm hinge solve: the axis closest to vertical that carries the motor point onto its folded target in one rotation; pivot group at the hinge, beam as a tube loft.
Motors/rotors/hubs as lathes; blades as a parametric airfoil sweep (chord, thickness, twist from pitch, camber, sweep).
Sensors and small parts placed by raycasting the shell and aligning to the hit normal; small static parts merged per material.
Textures: seeded fBm DataTextures with independent fields for albedo mottle (seeds 11/61/101), roughness blotch (103), bump grain (107); loft UV for seams, metre box UV for grain.
Two LODs from the same builder (hero / table) with identical node names and API.
